title: Krakow - reputable driver/guides
body:
O.P.
Hi everyone,
I'm planning a short stop in Krakow later this year and I'm looking for recommendations for a reputable company or private guide that can provide an English-speaking driver/guide for a day trip from Kraków to a village approximately 150km away.
The village is my grandfather's birth place, I'd like to visit the village and its church. If possible, I'd also appreciate a guide who could help me communicate with the parish priest to ask whether the parish still holds baptism, marriage or other records from that period, or knows where they may have been archived.
